summary: Let genie-freshness and typescript-client skip their steps when a trusted evidence note covers the exact tree

schema.detail: No daemon claim or portable record change.

rules.detail: Two required checks, genie-freshness and typescript-client, skip all steps but the checkout when their evidence gate decides skip; they keep their names, still conclude success and still satisfy every needs on them. The merge queue and how main lands are unchanged. No note exists for either check yet, so both run in full until a producer writes one.

compatibility.detail: Both jobs now also need their evidence-gate job, so they start about 10 to 30 seconds later while no note exists. A failed or skipped gate job never skips them.

manual.detail: The central evidence workflow pin needs its usual rotation because fleet.yml changed.

recovery.detail: Reverting restores the previous workflow; no state is written.
